intent.proves: Every endpoint has an authentication on itself or on its collection.
intent.scope: all endpoints; an anonymous remote endpoint is reported as an offender

bindings.reason: Handler not reserved: needs a field-predicate projection over the tool's rows; mcp-count counts rows only. Authentication exposure in the endpoint model not verified.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(e.EndpointId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ISNULL(e.EndpointName, N'') FROM [Endpoint] e LEFT JOIN EndpointCollection c ON c.EndpointCollectionId = e.EndpointCollectionId WHERE ISNULL(e.EndpointAuthenticationId, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(c.EndpointCollectionAuthenticationId, 0) = 0

sources.ref: nuget Dynamicweb.DataIntegration 10.29.8 (table and column names in assembly SQL strings)
